title: SAP Consolidations Manager, International Accounting
experience_required: GAQ327R292 We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve - leveraging AI, automation, and modern tooling to operate at the pace Databricks demands. We are looking for two Consolidations Managers to join our Global Accounting team based in India. These are foundational hires - you will own the end-to-end consolidation and intercompany accounting process across Databricks' 23-entity global footprint, build deep SAP Group Reporting expertise during our S/4HANA implementation, and establish the permanent organisational capability that scales with the business post go-live. This role blends hands-on consolidation execution with technical accounting judgment. As part of the Global Accounting organisation, you will ensure the accurate and timely production of consolidated financial statements under both US GAAP and IFRS, while partnering closely with International Accounting, Corporate Accounting, Tax, and FP&A to drive close integrity across all reporting frameworks. The impact you will have: Own and execute the global consolidation process end-to-end - intercompany reconciliation, elimination entries, currency translation, and multi-entity roll-up across our 23-entity footprint. Lead multi-GAAP close execution, producing parallel US GAAP and IFRS consolidated books each period, identifying and documenting reconciling differences for audit and leadership review. Build and own SAP Group Reporting expertise - serve as the accounting team's subject matter expert on SAP's consolidation engine, including configuration, period-end processing, and ongoing optimisation. Execute intercompany accounting across all entities - ensuring balances are reconciled, disputes are resolved within the close window, and elimination entries are complete and accurate. Perform monthly consolidation flux analysis, identifying and clearly articulating drivers behind significant period-over-period movements for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. Own FX translation and revaluation accounting - functional currency determination, translation adjustments, and CTA reconciliation across all international entities. Support new entity stand-up - partner with Tax, Legal, and International Accounting to establish consolidation processes, intercompany agreements, and reporting structures for new international selling entities as Databricks expands. Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external audit on consolidation, intercompany, and multi-GAAP reporting matters. Champion compliance with SOX controls across the consolidation process. Drive AI and automation adoption across consolidation workflows - including automated intercompany matching, elimination entry generation, and reconciliation tooling leveraging the Databricks platform. Partner with the Senior Manager, Close & Consolidation (US) to ensure seamless handoff and time-zone coverage for the most time-sensitive part of the global close. What we look for: BA/BS Degree with a focus in Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or Finance. 10+ years progressive accounting experience, with at least 5+ years specifically in consolidation, intercompany accounting, or international accounting within a US multinational framework. A Chartered Accountant (CA) or CPA equivalent certification is mandatory.  Deep understanding of US GAAP consolidation requirements (ASC 810, ASC 830) and working knowledge of IFRS consolidation standards (IFRS 10, IAS 21). Multi-GAAP reporting experience is strongly preferred. SAP S/4HANA experience required - specifically SAP Group Reporting or SAP BPC. Candidates with implementation experience will be prioritized. Proven experience managing intercompany accounting at scale - reconciliation, netting, dispute resolution, and elimination across a multi-entity, multi-currency environment. Experience with FX translation, functional currency assessment, and CTA accounting across complex international structures. Proven track record driving automation and process improvement in consolidation or close operations. Experience supporting external audits and SOX compliance in a consolidation context. Proven experience partnering with remote teams across different geographic areas, including with US-based accounting leadership, and the flexibility to support close timelines that span US Pacific Time hours. title: Director of Recruiting, Engineering & IT, Bangalore India
description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role As Director of Recruiting, Engineering and Information Technology, you’ll lead GitLab’s India-based recruiting efforts for Engineering and IT while helping shape technical hiring across the broader Asia-Pacific region. You’ll lead recruiting managers and their teams, set the regional talent strategy, and maintain direct ownership of senior and executive-level searches. Reporting to the Vice President of Talent Acquisition or an equivalent senior Talent Acquisition leader, you’ll help GitLab build exceptional technical teams in high-growth markets and create a scalable, well-documented recruiting model. You’ll serve as a trusted talent advisor to Engineering and IT leaders, using market intelligence and hiring data to guide workforce planning, organization design, and recruiting priorities. You’ll also strengthen recruiting leadership, candidate experience, and GitLab’s employer presence while supporting an all-remote, globally distributed team. What You’ll Do    Lead and develop a multi-layered recruiting organization, including recruiting managers and individual contributors, supporting 100 to 200 or more Engineering and IT requisitions across India and the broader Asia-Pacific region. Build recruiting management capability through coaching, clear expectations, structured operating cadences, and development plans for managers and individual contributors. Own GitLab’s most senior and executive-level technical searches in the region, including Vice President and C-suite-adjacent leadership roles. Set sourcing, talent pipeline, and market strategies for hard-to-fill roles in artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative artificial intelligence, security, infrastructure, and emerging technologies. Advise senior Engineering and IT leaders on organization design, workforce planning, compensation considerations, talent availability, and hiring priorities. Define regional hiring metrics and reporting, surface risks and bottlenecks to senior leaders, and recommend practical solutions that support predictable, high-quality hiring. Partner with People Business Partners, Compensation, Finance, and other recruiting leaders on headcount strategy, process improvements, tooling decisions, and company-wide talent priorities. Champion diversity, inclusion, and belonging, strengthen candidate and hiring team experiences, and build an effective operating model for all-remote collaboration across regions and time zones. What you'll bring Experience leading recruiting in high-growth technology companies, including enterprise-scale or similarly complex hiring environments. Experience managing recruiting managers or leading a multi-layered recruiting organization with accountability for team performance and development. Deep experience recruiting Engineering and IT talent, from individual contributor roles through senior and executive leadership positions. A record of sourcing, engaging, and closing passive candidates for senior technical and leadership roles in competitive markets. Deep knowledge of India’s technology talent market and experience setting hiring strategy across India and the broader Asia-Pacific region. Experience leading distributed teams and large, multi-portfolio hiring plans while advising senior leaders through growth and organizational change. Clear written and verbal communication when advising senior leaders on recruiting strategy and priorities. A data-informed approach to recruiting, including experience with hiring metrics, dashboards, market intelligence, applicant tracking systems, LinkedIn Recruiter, and sourcing tools. Experience with Greenhouse is helpful. We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and transferable experience. If you’re excited about this role, please apply even if your experience doesn’t match every item listed. About the team We help GitLab build the teams needed to co-create the future of software development. We work asynchronously across time zones and partner closely with Engineering, IT, People Business Partners, Compensation, and Finance to deliver high-quality hiring, strengthen leadership capability, and build transparent, scalable recruiting practices. title: Manager, Technical Delivery
experience_required: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. Snowflake is transforming the future of data and we are looking for a dynamic Manager, Technical Delivery to lead our Snowflake Professional Services team. As strategic experts in implementing the Snowflake platform, we engage with customers to optimise, accelerate, and drive meaningful business outcomes through cutting-edge technology solutions. As a Manager, Technical Delivery, you will lead teams executing complex migrations from legacy systems to the Snowflake platform. Your role will involve close collaboration with customers and system integrators to understand requirements, design robust migration strategies, and oversee seamless transitions. Your leadership will ensure that Snowflake is positioned as the premier solution in data warehousing and analytics, influencing both technical and executive stakeholders. AS A MANAGER, TECHNICAL DELIVERY AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL: - Lead and develop a team of Solutions Architects and Consultants, who serve as our Snowflake implementation, optimisation, development and delivery experts. • Mentor and manage a team of Snowflake Solutions Architects and Consultants helping them to develop their expertise - Play an active role in sourcing and screening potential candidates and managing the interview process - Be a technical expert on all aspects of Snowflake - Provide delivery quality oversight and guidance for Snowflake engagements by ensuring adherence to technical and delivery best practices - Work with Professional Services Practice Directors and Sales Account Team on sales pursuits – scoping migration projects, performing code assessments, pricing services, creating statements of work - Develop methodologies to improve our services delivery - Provide guidance on how to resolve customer-specific technical challenges • Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing - Present our methodologies, capabilities to both internal teams, external partners and customers OUR IDEAL MANAGER, TECHNICAL DELIVERY WILL HAVE: - Minimum 10 years of experience working with customers in a pre-sales or post-sales technical role - Minimum 5 years of people management experience; experience mentoring, coaching and developing teams - Minimum 5 years of experience in selling professional services; scoping large projects, writing statements of work - Extensive knowledge of and experience with large-scale database technology (e.g. Oracle, Teradata, Netezza, Greenplum, etc.) - Experience with non-relational platforms and tools for large-scale data processing (e.g. Hadoop, HBase) - Familiarity and experience with common data integration and data transformation tools (e.g. Informatica, DataStage, Talend, Matillion) - Familiarity and experience with common BI and data exploration tools (e.g. Microstrategy, Business Objects, Tableau) - University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience - Outstanding skills presenting to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos - Understanding of complete data analytics stack and workflow, from ETL to data platform design to BI and analytics tools - Strong skills in databases, data warehouses, and data processing - Extensive hands-on expertise with SQL and SQL analytics - Experience working with Code Agents in automating and accelerating development - Experience and track record of success selling data and/or analytics software to enterprise customers; includes proven skills identifying key stakeholders, winning value propositions, and compelling events - Scripting experience with Python, Ruby, Perl, Bash - Ability and flexibility to travel to work with customers on-site up to 25% of the time Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.
